news.title: Agentic AI is Transforming Modern Cloud & DevOps Pipelines
news.content: AI agents are increasingly managing complex CI/CD tasks, auto-remediating production anomalies, and optimizing resource configurations dynamically. By integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with platform APIs, these agents can read log outputs, synthesize code patches, and execute Terraform deployments autonomously, significantly reducing the Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) for cloud incidents.
